name: bookingmaster
description: Booking platform for sports venues: an owner console and a public self-serve booking page.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run migrate && npm run seed && PORT=${E2E_PORT:-3100} NODE_ENV=test node backend/dist/main.js > e2e/.server.log 2>&1
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
